import json
import numpy as np
import trimesh
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d.art3d import Poly3DCollection
m=trimesh.load('inspection.stl',force='mesh')
print('mesh_bounds',m.bounds.tolist())
print('mesh_faces',len(m.faces),'watertight',m.is_watertight,'components',len(m.split()),'volume',m.volume)
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(12,7))
ax=fig.add_subplot(111,projection='3d')
tri=m.vertices[m.faces]
norm=m.face_normals
light=np.array([-.4,-.5,1.]);light/=np.linalg.norm(light)
shade=.40+.55*np.clip(norm@light,0,1)
colors=np.column_stack([shade*.75,shade*.83,shade, np.ones(len(shade))])
poly=Poly3DCollection(tri,facecolors=colors,edgecolors='none',linewidths=0)
ax.add_collection3d(poly)
ax.set(xlim=(-56,56),ylim=(-56,56),zlim=(-4,33))
ax.set_box_aspect((112,112,37));ax.view_init(elev=34,azim=-64)
ax.set_axis_off()
fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig('model_inspection.png',dpi=150);plt.close(fig)
for name,orig,norm in [('midplate',[0,0,3.605],[0,0,1]),('axial',[0,0,0],[1,0,0])]:
 s=m.section(plane_origin=orig,plane_normal=norm)
 fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,8))
 for curve in s.discrete:
  if name=='midplate':ax.plot(curve[:,0],curve[:,1],color='black',lw=1)
  else:ax.plot(curve[:,2],curve[:,1],color='black',lw=1)
 ax.set_aspect('equal');ax.grid(alpha=.15)
 fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(name+'_inspection.png',dpi=140);plt.close(fig)

'@

python '"'inspect_model.py'"

public_events.text: The section and tooth-overlay checks match the drawing, and an independent topology review found no feature or connectivity issues. The tooth outline already falls within the source line width, so I’m retaining it and saving the final DWG. The main assumptions are the 28 mm overall length and smooth nominal openings for the M6 threads.

arguments.lisp:
(setvar "CMDECHO" 1)
(setvar "LOGFILEPATH" "[private value removed]")
(setvar "LOGFILEMODE" 1)
(setvar "OSMODE" 0)
(setvar "INSUNITS" 4)
(setvar "MEASUREMENT" 1)
(setq solids (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID") (410 . "Model"))))
(setq modelentities (ssget "_X" '((410 . "Model"))))
(setq body (ssname solids 0))
(command "_.SOLIDEDIT" "_Body" "_Check" body "_eXit" "_eXit")
(command "_.AUDIT" "_Yes")
(command "_.MASSPROP" body "" "_Yes" "[private value removed]")
(setq f (open "[private value removed]" "w"))
(write-line (strcat "Model-space 3DSOLID count: " (itoa (sslength solids))) f)
(write-line (strcat "Model-space entity count: " (itoa (sslength modelentities))) f)
(write-line (strcat "Solid handle: " (cdr (assoc 5 (entget body)))) f)
(write-line (strcat "Command state after ACIS check and audit: " (getvar "CMDNAMES")) f)
(write-line (strcat "Drawing units (4=mm): " (itoa (getvar "INSUNITS"))) f)
(write-line (strcat "Native command log: " (getvar "LOGFILENAME")) f)
(close f)
(setvar "FACETRES" 10)
(setvar "ISOLINES" 4)
(setvar "DISPSILH" 1)
(command "_.UCS" "_World")
(command "_.VPOINT" "_non" '(1 -1 1))
(command "_.ZOOM" "_Extents")
(command "_.VSCURRENT" "_Conceptual")
(princ "\nFINAL_SUBMISSION_VALIDATED\n")
(setvar "LOGFILEMODE" 0)
